title: Sindh Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2012

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2012
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 2012
ORDINANCE VII OF 2012
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2012
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Civil
Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
5th September, 2012]
No.S.Legis.1(7)/2012,
dated 5-9-2012.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:---
Preamble.---Whereas to
further amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973, in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the Governor is pleased
to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:---
1. Short title and
Commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2012.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.

Amendment of section 9-A of Sindh Act No.XIV of 1973

ORDINANCE VII OF 2012
ORDINANCE VII OF 2012
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2012
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
5th September, 2012]
No.S.Legis.1(7)/2012,
dated 5-9-2012.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:---
Preamble.---Whereas to further amend the Sindh Civil Servants
Act, 1973, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the Governor is pleased
to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:---
2. Amendment of section 9-A
of Sindh Act No.XIV of 1973.---In
the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973, for section 9-A, the following shall be
substituted:---
"9-A. (1) Notwithstanding
anything contained in this Act or any other law for the time being in force or
any judgment of any court, a civil servant who provenly exhibits the act of
gallantry while performing his duties or very exceptional performance beyond
the call of duty, may be granted out of turn promotion or award or reward by
Government.
(2) All the out of turn
promotions made under section 9-A before the commencement of this Ordinance,
shall be deemed to have been made under this section on regular basis."
